relationships.subject: TRPV1+ visceral afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic stimulation of TRPV1+ visceral afferents enhanced Iba-1 immunoreactivity in both T10–L1 and L6–S1 spinal cord sections as found in DSS condition

relationships.subject: TRPV1+ visceral afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic activation of TRPV1+ visceral afferents induced VHS in response to mild and noxious colorectal distension, compared with control

relationships.subject: TRPV1+ visceral afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: acute activation of TRPV1-hM3Dq neurons induced a 2-fold increase of ATP release

relationships.subject: TRPV1+ visceral afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: P2RY12 protein level was increased in both T10–L1 and L6–S1 spinal cord sections from TRPV1-hM3Dq mice compared with the vehicle group

relationships.subject: P2RY12
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of P2RY12 prevented microglial reactivity and chronic VHS post-colitis.

relationships.subject: TRPV1+ visceral afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of TRPV1+ visceral afferents in naïve mice was sufficient to induce an inflammatory response in the colon

key_findings: Chemogenetic inhibition of TRPV1+ afferents prevented spinal microglial activation and visceral hypersensitivity in colitis; activation alone induced both.
Neuronal ATP release and microglial P2RY12 mediate chronic visceral pain; P2RY12 inhibition prevented chronic VHS.
